```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(0)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This file reads `allmypackages.txt` and creates an `rda` file.

```{r readallpacks}
(allmypackages <- read.table("allmypackages.txt",header=TRUE))
```


### Package dataset {-}

Following lines create `allmypackages.rda`, residing in the `data/` directory of the package.

```{r,label=savepackdataset}
save(allmypackages, file="allmypackages.rda")
```
